items.name: Broken-Collar Bracer
items.lore: Iron from a thrall's collar, beaten flat. It was a symbol of one thing. Now it is a symbol of another.

items.name: Freedman's Cloak
items.lore: Grey wool, plain and new. The first thing Ketil ever owned.

items.name: Runaway's Ring
items.lore: A ring hidden in a thrall's mouth for three years.

items.name: Price-Paid Charm
items.lore: A little silver coin, holed and hung on a thong: the last coin of a thrall's price.

items.name: Tomte's Porridge-Spoon
items.lore: A tiny wooden spoon. Leave it out at Yule, and something will thank you.

items.name: Cradle-Quilt Cloak
items.lore: Stitched from a baby's quilt, let out and let out again. It smells of milk and hay.

items.name: Nisse's Red Cap
items.lore: A tomte's pointed red cap, absurdly small. It sits in your pack and somehow helps.

items.name: Barn-Beam Bracer
items.lore: Oak from a barn that burned. It is still warm.

items.name: Crab-Shell Bracer
items.lore: Rock-crab shell, lashed on with gut.

items.name: Audliten Net-Ring
items.lore: A fisher's ring, knotted from net-cord and wire.

items.name: Ant-Hill Charm
items.lore: A worker ant in amber.

items.name: Furrow-Walker's Belt
items.lore: A farmer's belt, patched many times.

items.name: Ant-Soldier Mandible Ring
items.lore: Big enough to be a ring. Sharp enough to be a weapon.

items.name: Dvalin Farmer's Cloak
items.lore: Brown, waxed, and smelling of rain.

items.name: Dirge-Bell Charm
items.lore: A little bronze bell. It rings once, then never again.

items.name: Old-Road Walker's Ring
items.lore: Found on the road. Whose, nobody knows.

items.name: Ghoul-Ward Torc
items.lore: Rowan wood bound in iron.

items.name: Barrow-Road Bracer
items.lore: Dark leather, scored with warding runes.

items.name: Dwarf-Rune Stone
items.lore: A chip of the barrow's runestone. The runes say 'cold'.

items.name: Barrow-King's Ring
items.lore: A dwarf lord's ring, too big for any finger you have.

items.name: Sealed-Door Mantle
items.lore: Stone-grey, from the barrow's door-hangings.

items.name: Pillager's Sack-Belt
items.lore: A tomte's swag-sack, cut down into a belt.

items.name: Farmhouse Hearth Charm
items.lore: A coal from a hearth the tomte didn't get to.

items.name: Aggressor's Iron Cap
items.lore: A tomte's iron cap, small enough to be a charm.

items.name: Barn-Watch Bracer
items.lore: Leather, with a barn-owl stamped on it.

items.name: Sveawolf-Fur Collar
items.lore: Grey fur, thick enough for any winter. Nearly.

items.name: Shepherd's Crook-Ring
items.lore: Iron, bent like a crook.

items.name: Lupine-Fang Torc
items.lore: Fangs on a leather thong, every one longer than a finger.

items.name: Moor-Runner's Belt
items.lore: Light, quick, and made to run in.

items.name: Grey-Hame Scrap Charm
items.lore: A scrap of wolf-hame. It smells of blood and frost.

items.name: Scout-Hunter's Bracer
items.lore: Light leather, for long stalking.

items.name: Ulfrstead Door-Nail Ring
items.lore: An iron nail from Ulfrstead's door, bent into a ring.

items.name: Hame-Breaker's Mantle
items.lore: League grey, with the wolf struck through.

items.name: League Oath-Torc
items.lore: The Steading-League's oath, twisted in silver.

items.name: Envy-Drake Scale Charm
items.lore: Green and gold. It's warm, like something alive.

items.name: Lair-Road Belt
items.lore: Scorched at the edges.

items.name: Silverscale Bracer
items.lore: Small silver scales, sewn on overlapping.

items.name: Brood-Watcher's Ring
items.lore: Silver, set with a drakeling's eye-stone.

items.name: Wyrm-Tongue's Whistle
items.lore: A bone whistle. The drakelings would come if you blew it. Don't.

items.name: Vasudheim Huscarl Mantle
items.lore: Royal blue, the King's own huscarls.

items.name: Brood-Breaker's Torc
items.lore: Iron, with a silver scale hammered flat into it.
